{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Drawing → `uViewArranger`
{{% /callout %}}

Aligns and distributes the selected drawing views — select two or more views on a sheet first, then click an align or distribute button; each button acts immediately, there is no separate Apply step.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Align Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom** | Snaps every selected view to that edge (or centre line) of the selection's own bounding box. |
| **Distribute Horizontally / Vertically** | Spaces the selected views out evenly along that axis, using whichever spacing mode is set below. |
| **Use restriction box** | Off (default): each view's own frame is used for alignment/spacing. On: its restriction box is used instead. |
| **Spacing mode** | Equal gaps (default, no value needed): even gaps between views. Fixed gap: an exact gap size, entered in the value box. Fixed pitch: an exact centre-to-centre spacing, entered in the value box. |
